correctness.rationale: Exact recurrence gives P_plus(1)=sqrt(Delta); root factorization gives lower spectral bound, with equality only at negative repeated root. Explicit binomial-corrected positive weights attain equality; delayed selector covers the low-gain region by open Schur stability, and P_minus(1)<0 forces a real unstable root. Symbolic polynomial checks and direct companion-Jacobian tests passed; experiments are not used for infinite conclusions.
